description: This file is a CMake script defining a function 'compile_aidl' used during build time to generate source code from AIDL files. It handles the invocation of the aidl compiler with specified parameters and options.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: A CMake function to generate source files from AIDL files, given various parameters like aidl compiler path, flags, language, include directories, and target directory.
